summary: Narrow campus lane against the Aquatic Centre; signed loading zone, no room.
reasons: Narrow lane, trees and wall each side

drivers.seclusion: University buildings all round, no homes; but busy campus lane, not a place to sleep unnoticed.
drivers.access_and_room: Lane squeezed between large building and trees; no clear ground beside it. A car sits parked in the lane's far end.
drivers.traffic: Campus service and pedestrian traffic, car park just west.
drivers.convention: Loading zone Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, 2 hours max; no overnight convention.

sun_shade: Tree canopy over the lane; big roof on the east side.
cannot_judge: Whether the lane is open to vehicles at night
